items.question: Can I sell memberships and subscriptions?
items.answer: Yes. Courses, downloads and your community can each have free, one-time, monthly or yearly subscription, and instalment plans. Community plans can also include courses and downloads.

items.question: Can learners pay in instalments?
items.answer: Yes. Add an instalment plan of 2 to 60 monthly payments next to your other plans, and learners pick the one that suits them at checkout.

items.question: Does CourseLit take a cut of my sales?
items.answer: No. Learners pay through your own Stripe, Lemon Squeezy or Razorpay account and CourseLit charges no transaction fee on any plan. Your payment provider's own fees still apply.

items.question: Do I need my own website?
items.answer: No. Every school comes with a website you edit in a visual editor, including a blog and sales pages for each product. You can connect your own domain, such as learn.yourname.com.

items.question: How do I grow my email list?
items.answer: Give away a digital download as a lead magnet. Everyone who signs up joins your contacts, and you can welcome them with an automated sequence and send broadcasts later.

items.question: What happens after the free trial?
items.answer: Your trial lasts 14 days and needs no card. To keep your school, choose Pro or Business. If you don't, your school becomes read-only for 15 days and is then deleted.

items.question: Is CourseLit open source?
items.answer: Yes, under AGPL-3.0, and has been since 2019. You can use our cloud or host CourseLit on your own servers with every feature included.
